reference_images.use: sole character geometry, black-ink weight, whitespace, and detached-accent style reference

reference_policy: Locked V9 is the sole render reference. V10/V11 and all retired, rejected, legacy, or hand-drawn candidates are forbidden as visual references, prompt inputs, pixel sources, fallbacks, or runtime resources.
named_visible_variable: functional-context accent vocabulary only; no face component may be changed

menu_active.trigger: menu is open or navigation selection is active
menu_active.planned_choreography: gaze settles, brows answer, then one compact menu-selection accent enters and rests; no static-card carousel

recording_active.trigger: recording has started and remains active
recording_active.planned_choreography: gaze focuses, brows settle, then paired listening ripples pulse sparsely around the unchanged V9 eye identity

upgrade_active.trigger: a confirmed firmware upgrade is transferring or verifying
upgrade_active.planned_choreography: the unchanged V9 face stays steady while approved progress segments appear one at a time; before accepted source components exist every upgrade phase remains fail-closed

prompt_delta: Generate one white square monochrome source-art panel for the locked V9 Companion. It contains exactly three widely separated detached functional accent groups, all made from crisp black rounded pixel-ink marks with the same gentle stroke weight and generous whitespace as V9. Group A, menu active: a compact vertical trio of three small rounded ink dots, slightly irregular and quiet, suitable as a sparse choice/consideration cue. Group B, recording active: a symmetric pair of very small inward-facing listening ripple strokes, each side formed from two short rounded arcs, restrained and airy. Group C, upgrade active: four separate tiny rounded progress segments arranged on a loose small ring, with visible gaps so each segment can be independently extracted and revealed in sequence. This is a source-art component panel only: no character face, no full expression, no animation frame, no border, and no labels. Leave generous blank space around every group and between every upgrade segment for later source-mask extraction.
inherited_identity_gates: Do not redraw, include, alter, crop, or imply the V9 eye pair, highlights, brows, nose, mouth, cheeks, face silhouette, cat outline, ears, whiskers, or device frame.
Keep only V9's crisp black-on-white monochrome, sparse low-detail visual grammar, calm rounded stroke personality, and untextured white field.
This one panel changes only detached functional accent vocabulary. It cannot be interpreted as a complete face or a complete state card.
negative_constraints: no face, eyes, brows, nose, mouth, cheeks, head, character silhouette, whole expression card, or body
no labels, letters, numbers, words, UI, grid, border, speech bubble, emoji, progress percentage, arrow, checkmark, exclamation, question mark, or generic typography
no sparkle, heart, moon, crescent, Z, cat detail, whiskers, starburst, decoration, confetti, or a fourth accent group
no color, grayscale, texture, shadow, gradient, anti-aliasing, outline glyph, glossy vector icon, or cartoon clipart
no V10, V11, V12, V13, V14, V15, V16, legacy, retired, rejected, or alternate visual reference

required: generated file SHA256 and image-generation request are recorded together
exactly three extractable context groups: menu trio, symmetric recording ripple pair, and four separately extractable upgrade segments
no face, labels, borders, forbidden glyphs, or non-V9 visual language
source-only 200x200 reassembly proves zero overlap with protected V9 face roles for every planned local offset
menu, recording, and upgrade bindings remain unbound and runtime inactive until separate machine export plus canonical owner art acceptance
forbidden: code-drawn, traced, or procedurally generated facial features or function glyphs
whole-face/CEMP runtime playback, ordinary-face fallback, or static state-card rotation
binding the candidate before source review, component extraction audit, machine gate, and canonical owner acceptance
using the upgrade group to pretend upgrade visuals are complete before the group is accepted
